fr.title: [Logistique internationale n°15] Des données plus intelligentes, des navires plus propres : où se dirige le fret mondial, avec une revue complète du cours

segments.src: > Global logistics is changing in two ways at once. Data is making each shipment visible from start to finish, and climate rules are changing what ships burn and what that costs. Both changes build on the basics: modes, documents, contracts, and costs.
segments.tr: > La logistique mondiale évolue sur deux fronts à la fois. Les données rendent chaque expédition visible du début à la fin, et les règles climatiques modifient ce que brûlent les navires et ce que cela coûte. Ces deux évolutions reposent sur les fondamentaux : modes de transport, documents, contrats et coûts.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concept du jour

segments.src: Smart (digital) logistics: from "Where is my box?"
segments.tr: Logistique intelligente (numérique) : de « Où est mon conteneur ? »

segments.src: to "I already know"**
segments.tr: à « Je le sais déjà »**

segments.src: For most of its history, international shipping ran on paper and phone calls.
segments.tr: Pendant la majeure partie de son histoire, le transport maritime international a fonctionné avec du papier et des appels téléphoniques.

segments.src: A shipper often learned a container was late only after it failed to show up.
segments.tr: Un chargeur ne découvrait souvent qu'un conteneur était en retard qu'au moment où il ne se présentait pas.

segments.src: Digital logistics tries to close that information gap.
segments.tr: La logistique numérique cherche à combler ce déficit d'information.

segments.src: Here are the main tools:
segments.tr: Voici les principaux outils :

segments.src: - **IoT sensors and trackers.** These are small devices on containers or pallets that report location, temperature, humidity, or shock. They matter most for "reefer" (refrigerated) cargo such as fruit or vaccines.
segments.tr: - **Capteurs et traceurs IoT.** Ce sont de petits dispositifs placés sur les conteneurs ou les palettes, qui transmettent la position, la température, l'humidité ou les chocs. Ils sont essentiels pour les marchandises « reefer » (réfrigérées), comme les fruits ou les vaccins.

segments.src: - **Electronic Bill of Lading (eBL).** The bill of lading is the key shipping document. It serves as a receipt, a contract of carriage, and, in its negotiable form, a document of title. Paper originals often travel by courier and can arrive after the ship does. An eBL moves that same function online. Laws that recognize electronic trade documents, such as the UK's Electronic Trade Documents Act 2023, have made eBLs easier to adopt.
segments.tr: - **Connaissement électronique (eBL).** Le connaissement (bill of lading) est le document clé du transport maritime. Il sert de reçu, de contrat de transport et, sous sa forme négociable, de titre de propriété. Les originaux papier voyagent souvent par coursier et peuvent arriver après le navire. Un eBL assure la même fonction en ligne. Les textes qui reconnaissent les documents commerciaux électroniques, comme le *Electronic Trade Documents Act 2023* britannique, ont facilité son adoption.

segments.src: - **Platforms and data sharing.** Carriers, ports, forwarders, and customs agencies increasingly share data through standard formats and APIs. That lets everyone work from the same estimated arrival time.
segments.tr: - **Plateformes et partage de données.** Les transporteurs, ports, transitaires et douanes partagent de plus en plus leurs données via des formats standards et des API. Chacun travaille ainsi à partir du même délai d'arrivée estimé.

segments.src: - **Digital twins and AI forecasting.** A digital twin is a virtual model of a port, warehouse, or network. Companies use it to test scenarios, such as "What if this terminal closes for three days?", before they happen in real life.
segments.tr: - **Jumeaux numériques et prévisions par IA.** Un jumeau numérique est un modèle virtuel d'un port, d'un entrepôt ou d'un réseau. Les entreprises s'en servent pour tester des scénarios, par exemple « Et si ce terminal fermait pendant trois jours ? », avant que cela ne se produise réellement.

segments.src: The goal is **visibility**, and visibility makes three things possible: planning ahead, holding less safety stock, and reacting faster when something goes wrong.
segments.tr: L'objectif est la **visibilité**, et la visibilité rend trois choses possibles : anticiper, détenir moins de stock de sécurité et réagir plus vite en cas de problème.

segments.src: Green logistics: the decarbonization squeeze**
segments.tr: Logistique verte : la pression de la décarbonation**

segments.src: Shipping carries roughly 80% of world trade by volume.
segments.tr: Le transport maritime représente environ 80 % du commerce mondial en volume.

segments.src: It also produces about 3% of global greenhouse gas emissions.
segments.tr: Il produit aussi environ 3 % des émissions mondiales de gaz à effet de serre.

segments.src: The **International Maritime Organization (IMO)**, the UN agency that regulates shipping, adopted a revised GHG Strategy in 2023 with these targets:
segments.tr: L'**Organisation maritime internationale (OMI)**, l'agence de l'ONU qui régule le transport maritime, a adopté en 2023 une stratégie GES révisée fixant les objectifs suivants :

segments.src: - Reach **net-zero emissions by or around 2050**
segments.tr: - Atteindre des **émissions nettes nulles d'ici 2050 environ** ou à cette date

segments.src: - Cut emissions by at least 20% (striving for 30%) by 2030 and by at least 70% (striving for 80%) by 2040, both compared with 2008 levels
segments.tr: - Réduire les émissions d'au moins 20 % (visant 30 %) d'ici 2030, et d'au moins 70 % (visant 80 %) d'ici 2040, par rapport aux niveaux de 2008

segments.src: Some rules already apply.
segments.tr: Certaines règles s'appliquent déjà.

segments.src: Since January 2023, ships have been rated on energy efficiency (**EEXI**) and on yearly carbon intensity (**CII**, a grade from A to E).
segments.tr: Depuis janvier 2023, les navires sont évalués sur leur efficacité énergétique (**EEXI**) et sur leur intensité carbone annuelle (**CII**, une note de A à E).

segments.src: The IMO is also developing a global framework that would combine a fuel-emissions standard with a carbon price.
segments.tr: L'OMI élabore aussi un cadre mondial qui combinerait une norme sur les émissions des carburants et un prix du carbone.

segments.src: Member states approved a draft in April 2025, but the vote to formally adopt it was postponed in October 2025.
segments.tr: Les États membres ont approuvé un projet en avril 2025, mais le vote d'adoption formelle a été reporté en octobre 2025.

segments.src: The final shape and timing of this global measure are still being negotiated.
segments.tr: La forme finale et le calendrier de cette mesure mondiale sont encore en négociation.

segments.src: Regional rules are moving faster.
segments.tr: Les règles régionales avancent plus vite.

segments.src: Since 2024, the **EU Emissions Trading System** has required shipping companies to buy allowances for emissions on voyages to and from EU ports.
segments.tr: Depuis 2024, le **système d'échange de quotas d'émission de l'UE (SEQE-UE)** oblige les compagnies maritimes à acheter des quotas pour les émissions des voyages à destination et en provenance des ports de l'UE.

segments.src: **FuelEU Maritime** started in 2025 and requires the fuel used on board to become gradually less carbon-intensive.
segments.tr: **FuelEU Maritime** a débuté en 2025 et exige que le carburant utilisé à bord devienne progressivement moins intensif en carbone.

segments.src: What changes in practice:
segments.tr: Ce qui change concrètement :

segments.src: - **Slow steaming.** Ships sail slower to burn less fuel, so transit times get longer.
segments.tr: - **Navigation à vitesse réduite (slow steaming).** Les navires naviguent plus lentement pour consommer moins de carburant, ce qui allonge les délais de transit.

segments.src: - **New fuels.** LNG, methanol, and ammonia are being tested or adopted, and each comes with its own cost and infrastructure challenges.
segments.tr: - **Nouveaux carburants.** Le GNL, le méthanol et l'ammoniac sont testés ou adoptés, chacun avec ses propres défis de coût et d'infrastructure.

segments.src: - **Carbon surcharges.** Carriers pass compliance costs to shippers as new line items on freight invoices.
segments.tr: - **Surcharges carbone.** Les transporteurs répercutent les coûts de conformité sur les chargeurs, sous forme de nouvelles lignes sur les factures de fret.

segments.src: Put simply, **emissions are becoming a cost that shows up on the invoice.** That puts carbon in the same category as fuel or port fees.
segments.tr: En résumé, **les émissions deviennent un coût qui apparaît sur la facture.** Le carbone rejoint ainsi le carburant ou les frais portuaires.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie quotidienne

segments.src: Think of a mid-sized home-goods retailer in Columbus, Ohio, that imports ceramic cookware from a factory near Shanghai.
segments.tr: Imaginez un distributeur d'articles pour la maison de taille moyenne à Columbus, dans l'Ohio, qui importe des ustensiles de cuisine en céramique d'une usine proche de Shanghai.

segments.src: A few years ago, the import manager tracked the container by checking the carrier's website and emailing the freight forwarder.
segments.tr: Il y a quelques années, le responsable des importations suivait le conteneur en consultant le site du transporteur et en envoyant des e-mails au transitaire.

segments.src: When the ship waited offshore at the Port of Los Angeles, they found out late and had to pay for expedited trucking to get products on shelves before Black Friday.
segments.tr: Lorsque le navire attendait au large du port de Los Angeles, ils l'apprenaient tardivement et devaient payer un transport routier express pour que les produits arrivent en rayon avant le Black Friday.

segments.src: Today, the container has a GPS tracker.
segments.tr: Aujourd'hui, le conteneur est équipé d'un traceur GPS.

segments.src: The forwarder's dashboard shows a predicted arrival that updates when congestion builds at the port.
segments.tr: Le tableau de bord du transitaire affiche une date d'arrivée prévue qui se met à jour dès que la congestion s'installe au port.

segments.src: The bill of lading is electronic, so the customs broker can file entry documents before the ship berths.
segments.tr: Le connaissement étant électronique, le courtier en douane peut déposer les documents d'entrée avant l'accostage du navire.

segments.src: When the dashboard flagged a likely four-day delay, the retailer switched part of the shipment to an East Coast routing ahead of time.
segments.tr: Quand le tableau de bord a signalé un retard probable de quatre jours, le distributeur a réorienté à l'avance une partie de l'expédition vers une route par la côte Est.

segments.src: Their freight quote also includes a new line: an environmental or emissions surcharge from the ocean carrier.
segments.tr: Leur devis de fret comprend aussi une nouvelle ligne : une surcharge environnementale ou liée aux émissions, facturée par le transporteur maritime.

segments.src: On a $3,000 container move, it may be a small share of the total, but the retailer's buyers now compare carriers on the cost and carbon profile of each lane as well as on rate and speed.
segments.tr: Sur un envoi de conteneur de 3 000 $, elle représente peut-être une petite part du total, mais les acheteurs du distributeur comparent désormais les transporteurs sur le coût et le profil carbone de chaque liaison, en plus du tarif et de la vitesse.

segments.src: Some large US brands also ask suppliers for shipment-level emissions data to support their corporate climate reporting.
segments.tr: Certaines grandes marques américaines demandent aussi à leurs fournisseurs des données d'émissions par expédition pour soutenir leur reporting climatique d'entreprise.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Résumé en 3 points

segments.src: 1. Digital logistics (IoT tracking, electronic bills of lading, shared data platforms, digital twins) aims at **end-to-end visibility**, which allows earlier decisions and leaner inventory.
segments.tr: 1. La logistique numérique (suivi IoT, connaissements électroniques, plateformes de données partagées, jumeaux numériques) vise la **visibilité de bout en bout**, qui permet de décider plus tôt et de réduire les stocks.

segments.src: 2. IMO targets (net-zero by around 2050) plus regional rules like the EU ETS and FuelEU Maritime are turning **carbon into a real shipping cost**, which shippers see as surcharges and slower sailings.
segments.tr: 2. Les objectifs de l'OMI (émissions nettes nulles vers 2050), complétés par des règles régionales comme le SEQE-UE et FuelEU Maritime, font du **carbone un véritable coût du transport maritime**, que les chargeurs voient sous forme de surcharges et de traversées plus lentes.

segments.src: 3. These trends sit on top of the course fundamentals: **choosing the mode, using Incoterms, clearing customs, and managing total landed cost.** Technology and regulation change the inputs, but the logic stays the same.
segments.tr: 3. Ces tendances s'ajoutent aux fondamentaux du cours : **choisir le mode de transport, utiliser les Incoterms, dédouaner et gérer le coût total rendu.** La technologie et la réglementation changent les données d'entrée, mais la logique reste la même.

segments.src: **Course wrap-up: the big picture in one pass**
segments.tr: **Bilan du cours : la vue d'ensemble en un coup d'œil**

segments.src: - **Modes:** Ocean freight is cheap and slow. Air freight is fast and expensive. Rail and truck connect the inland legs. Intermodal shipping combines them, usually built around the standard container (TEU/FEU).
segments.tr: - **Modes :** Le fret maritime est bon marché et lent. Le fret aérien est rapide et coûteux. Le rail et la route assurent les liaisons terrestres. Le transport multimodal combine ces modes, généralement autour du conteneur standard (EVP/FEU).

segments.src: - **Players:** Shippers, carriers, freight forwarders, NVOCCs, customs brokers, ports, and 3PLs.
segments.tr: - **Acteurs :** Chargeurs, transporteurs, transitaires, NVOCC, courtiers en douane, ports et prestataires logistiques (3PL).

segments.src: - **Contracts & risk:** Incoterms (such as FOB, CIF, and DAP) set who pays for what and where risk transfers. They do not decide who owns the goods.
segments.tr: - **Contrats et risques :** Les Incoterms (comme FOB, CIF et DAP) définissent qui paie quoi et à quel moment le risque est transféré. Ils ne déterminent pas qui est propriétaire de la marchandise.

segments.src: - **Documents:** Commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or air waybill, and certificate of origin.
segments.tr: - **Documents :** Facture commerciale, liste de colisage, connaissement ou lettre de transport aérien, et certificat d'origine.

segments.src: - **Border:** Customs classification (HS codes), valuation, duties, and trade agreements.
segments.tr: - **Frontière :** Classement douanier (codes SH), valeur en douane, droits et accords commerciaux.

segments.src: - **Money:** Total landed cost = product + freight + insurance + duties + handling + inventory carrying cost.
segments.tr: - **Argent :** Coût total rendu = produit + fret + assurance + droits + manutention + coût de détention du stock.

segments.src: - **Resilience:** Chokepoints, port congestion, and diversification, now joined by data visibility and carbon cost.
segments.tr: - **Résilience :** Goulets d'étranglement, congestion portuaire et diversification, désormais complétés par la visibilité des données et le coût carbone.

pt.title: [International Logistics #15] Logística Inteligente, Navios Mais Limpos: Para Onde Caminha o Frete Global, Mais uma Revisão do Curso Completo

segments.src: > Global logistics is changing in two ways at once. Data is making each shipment visible from start to finish, and climate rules are changing what ships burn and what that costs. Both changes build on the basics: modes, documents, contracts, and costs.
segments.tr: > A logística global está mudando em duas frentes ao mesmo tempo. Os dados estão tornando cada embarque visível do início ao fim, e as regras climáticas estão alterando o que os navios queimam e quanto isso custa. Ambas as mudanças se apoiam nos fundamentos: modais, documentos, contratos e custos.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Conceito de Hoje

segments.src: Smart (digital) logistics: from "Where is my box?"
segments.tr: Logística inteligente (digital): de "Onde está o meu contêiner?"

segments.src: to "I already know"**
segments.tr: a "Já sei onde está"**

segments.src: For most of its history, international shipping ran on paper and phone calls.
segments.tr: Durante a maior parte de sua história, o transporte internacional funcionou com papel e telefonemas.

segments.src: A shipper often learned a container was late only after it failed to show up.
segments.tr: Um exportador costumava descobrir que um contêiner estava atrasado somente quando ele não chegava.

segments.src: Digital logistics tries to close that information gap.
segments.tr: A logística digital tenta fechar essa lacuna de informação.

segments.src: Here are the main tools:
segments.tr: Estas são as principais ferramentas:

segments.src: - **IoT sensors and trackers.** These are small devices on containers or pallets that report location, temperature, humidity, or shock. They matter most for "reefer" (refrigerated) cargo such as fruit or vaccines.
segments.tr: - **Sensores e rastreadores IoT.** São pequenos dispositivos instalados em contêineres ou paletes que informam localização, temperatura, umidade ou choques. Eles são mais importantes para cargas "reefer" (refrigeradas), como frutas ou vacinas.

segments.src: - **Electronic Bill of Lading (eBL).** The bill of lading is the key shipping document. It serves as a receipt, a contract of carriage, and, in its negotiable form, a document of title. Paper originals often travel by courier and can arrive after the ship does. An eBL moves that same function online. Laws that recognize electronic trade documents, such as the UK's Electronic Trade Documents Act 2023, have made eBLs easier to adopt.
segments.tr: - **Conhecimento de Embarque Eletrônico (eBL).** O conhecimento de embarque (bill of lading) é o principal documento de transporte marítimo. Ele funciona como recibo, contrato de transporte e, em sua forma negociável, como título de propriedade. Os originais em papel costumam viajar por courier e podem chegar depois do navio. O eBL transfere essa mesma função para o meio online. Leis que reconhecem documentos comerciais eletrônicos, como o Electronic Trade Documents Act 2023 do Reino Unido, facilitaram a adoção do eBL.

segments.src: - **Platforms and data sharing.** Carriers, ports, forwarders, and customs agencies increasingly share data through standard formats and APIs. That lets everyone work from the same estimated arrival time.
segments.tr: - **Plataformas e compartilhamento de dados.** Transportadoras, portos, agentes de carga e agências alfandegárias compartilham cada vez mais dados por meio de formatos padronizados e APIs. Isso permite que todos trabalhem com a mesma previsão de chegada.

segments.src: - **Digital twins and AI forecasting.** A digital twin is a virtual model of a port, warehouse, or network. Companies use it to test scenarios, such as "What if this terminal closes for three days?", before they happen in real life.
segments.tr: - **Gêmeos digitais e previsão com IA.** Um gêmeo digital é um modelo virtual de um porto, armazém ou rede. As empresas o usam para testar cenários, como "E se este terminal fechar por três dias?", antes que eles aconteçam na vida real.

segments.src: The goal is **visibility**, and visibility makes three things possible: planning ahead, holding less safety stock, and reacting faster when something goes wrong.
segments.tr: O objetivo é a **visibilidade**, e a visibilidade torna possíveis três coisas: planejar com antecedência, manter menos estoque de segurança e reagir mais rapidamente quando algo dá errado.

segments.src: Green logistics: the decarbonization squeeze**
segments.tr: Logística verde: a pressão da descarbonização**

segments.src: Shipping carries roughly 80% of world trade by volume.
segments.tr: O transporte marítimo responde por cerca de 80% do comércio mundial em volume.

segments.src: It also produces about 3% of global greenhouse gas emissions.
segments.tr: Ele também produz cerca de 3% das emissões globais de gases de efeito estufa.

segments.src: The **International Maritime Organization (IMO)**, the UN agency that regulates shipping, adopted a revised GHG Strategy in 2023 with these targets:
segments.tr: A **Organização Marítima Internacional (IMO)**, agência da ONU que regula o transporte marítimo, adotou em 2023 uma Estratégia de GEE revisada com estas metas:

segments.src: - Reach **net-zero emissions by or around 2050**
segments.tr: - Atingir **emissões líquidas zero em torno de 2050 ou antes**

segments.src: - Cut emissions by at least 20% (striving for 30%) by 2030 and by at least 70% (striving for 80%) by 2040, both compared with 2008 levels
segments.tr: - Reduzir as emissões em pelo menos 20% (buscando 30%) até 2030 e em pelo menos 70% (buscando 80%) até 2040, ambas em relação aos níveis de 2008

segments.src: Some rules already apply.
segments.tr: Algumas regras já estão em vigor.

segments.src: Since January 2023, ships have been rated on energy efficiency (**EEXI**) and on yearly carbon intensity (**CII**, a grade from A to E).
segments.tr: Desde janeiro de 2023, os navios são avaliados quanto à eficiência energética (**EEXI**) e à intensidade de carbono anual (**CII**, uma classificação de A a E).

segments.src: The IMO is also developing a global framework that would combine a fuel-emissions standard with a carbon price.
segments.tr: A IMO também está desenvolvendo uma estrutura global que combinaria um padrão de emissões de combustível com um preço de carbono.

segments.src: Member states approved a draft in April 2025, but the vote to formally adopt it was postponed in October 2025.
segments.tr: Os Estados-membros aprovaram um rascunho em abril de 2025, mas a votação para adoção formal foi adiada em outubro de 2025.

segments.src: The final shape and timing of this global measure are still being negotiated.
segments.tr: A forma final e o cronograma dessa medida global ainda estão em negociação.

segments.src: Regional rules are moving faster.
segments.tr: As regras regionais estão avançando mais rapidamente.

segments.src: Since 2024, the **EU Emissions Trading System** has required shipping companies to buy allowances for emissions on voyages to and from EU ports.
segments.tr: Desde 2024, o **Sistema de Comércio de Emissões da UE (EU ETS)** exige que as empresas de navegação comprem permissões de emissão para viagens de e para portos da UE.

segments.src: **FuelEU Maritime** started in 2025 and requires the fuel used on board to become gradually less carbon-intensive.
segments.tr: O **FuelEU Maritime** começou em 2025 e exige que o combustível usado a bordo se torne gradualmente menos intensivo em carbono.

segments.src: What changes in practice:
segments.tr: Na prática, o que muda:

segments.src: - **Slow steaming.** Ships sail slower to burn less fuel, so transit times get longer.
segments.tr: - **Navegação lenta (slow steaming).** Os navios navegam mais devagar para queimar menos combustível, de modo que os tempos de trânsito ficam mais longos.

segments.src: - **New fuels.** LNG, methanol, and ammonia are being tested or adopted, and each comes with its own cost and infrastructure challenges.
segments.tr: - **Novos combustíveis.** GNL, metanol e amônia estão sendo testados ou adotados, e cada um traz seus próprios desafios de custo e infraestrutura.

segments.src: - **Carbon surcharges.** Carriers pass compliance costs to shippers as new line items on freight invoices.
segments.tr: - **Sobretaxas de carbono.** As transportadoras repassam os custos de conformidade aos embarcadores como novos itens nas faturas de frete.

segments.src: Put simply, **emissions are becoming a cost that shows up on the invoice.** That puts carbon in the same category as fuel or port fees.
segments.tr: Em outras palavras, **as emissões estão se tornando um custo que aparece na fatura.** Isso coloca o carbono na mesma categoria do combustível ou das taxas portuárias.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## No Dia a Dia

segments.src: Think of a mid-sized home-goods retailer in Columbus, Ohio, that imports ceramic cookware from a factory near Shanghai.
segments.tr: Pense em um varejista de utilidades para o lar de porte médio em Columbus, Ohio, que importa utensílios de cerâmica de uma fábrica perto de Xangai.

segments.src: A few years ago, the import manager tracked the container by checking the carrier's website and emailing the freight forwarder.
segments.tr: Alguns anos atrás, o gerente de importação acompanhava o contêiner consultando o site da transportadora e enviando e-mails ao agente de carga.

segments.src: When the ship waited offshore at the Port of Los Angeles, they found out late and had to pay for expedited trucking to get products on shelves before Black Friday.
segments.tr: Quando o navio ficou aguardando ao largo do Porto de Los Angeles, eles só souberam com atraso e tiveram de pagar transporte rodoviário expresso para colocar os produtos nas prateleiras antes da Black Friday.

segments.src: Today, the container has a GPS tracker.
segments.tr: Hoje, o contêiner tem um rastreador GPS.

segments.src: The forwarder's dashboard shows a predicted arrival that updates when congestion builds at the port.
segments.tr: O painel do agente de carga mostra uma chegada prevista que é atualizada quando a congestão se forma no porto.

segments.src: The bill of lading is electronic, so the customs broker can file entry documents before the ship berths.
segments.tr: O conhecimento de embarque é eletrônico, então o despachante aduaneiro pode registrar os documentos de entrada antes de o navio atracar.

segments.src: When the dashboard flagged a likely four-day delay, the retailer switched part of the shipment to an East Coast routing ahead of time.
segments.tr: Quando o painel sinalizou um provável atraso de quatro dias, o varejista redirecionou com antecedência parte da carga para uma rota da Costa Leste.

segments.src: Their freight quote also includes a new line: an environmental or emissions surcharge from the ocean carrier.
segments.tr: A cotação de frete deles também inclui um item novo: uma sobretaxa ambiental ou de emissões cobrada pela transportadora marítima.

segments.src: On a $3,000 container move, it may be a small share of the total, but the retailer's buyers now compare carriers on the cost and carbon profile of each lane as well as on rate and speed.
segments.tr: Em um transporte de contêiner de US$ 3.000, ela pode representar uma pequena parcela do total, mas os compradores do varejista agora comparam as transportadoras pelo perfil de custo e carbono de cada rota, além de taxa e velocidade.

segments.src: Some large US brands also ask suppliers for shipment-level emissions data to support their corporate climate reporting.
segments.tr: Algumas grandes marcas dos EUA também pedem aos fornecedores dados de emissões por embarque para apoiar seus relatórios corporativos de clima.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Resumo em 3 Linhas

segments.src: 1. Digital logistics (IoT tracking, electronic bills of lading, shared data platforms, digital twins) aims at **end-to-end visibility**, which allows earlier decisions and leaner inventory.
segments.tr: 1. A logística digital (rastreamento IoT, conhecimentos de embarque eletrônicos, plataformas de dados compartilhados, gêmeos digitais) visa à **visibilidade de ponta a ponta**, o que permite decisões mais rápidas e estoques mais enxutos.

segments.src: 2. IMO targets (net-zero by around 2050) plus regional rules like the EU ETS and FuelEU Maritime are turning **carbon into a real shipping cost**, which shippers see as surcharges and slower sailings.
segments.tr: 2. As metas da IMO (emissões líquidas zero em torno de 2050) somadas a regras regionais como o EU ETS e o FuelEU Maritime estão transformando o **carbono em um custo real do transporte marítimo**, que os embarcadores percebem como sobretaxas e viagens mais lentas.

segments.src: 3. These trends sit on top of the course fundamentals: **choosing the mode, using Incoterms, clearing customs, and managing total landed cost.** Technology and regulation change the inputs, but the logic stays the same.
segments.tr: 3. Essas tendências se apoiam nos fundamentos do curso: **escolher o modal, usar os Incoterms, fazer o desembaraço aduaneiro e gerenciar o custo total de entrega (total landed cost).** Tecnologia e regulação mudam os insumos, mas a lógica permanece a mesma.

segments.src: **Course wrap-up: the big picture in one pass**
segments.tr: **Encerramento do curso: o panorama geral em uma passada**

segments.src: - **Modes:** Ocean freight is cheap and slow. Air freight is fast and expensive. Rail and truck connect the inland legs. Intermodal shipping combines them, usually built around the standard container (TEU/FEU).
segments.tr: - **Modais:** O frete marítimo é barato e lento. O frete aéreo é rápido e caro. Ferrovia e rodovia conectam os trechos terrestres. A intermodalidade combina esses modais, geralmente em torno do contêiner padrão (TEU/FEU).

segments.src: - **Players:** Shippers, carriers, freight forwarders, NVOCCs, customs brokers, ports, and 3PLs.
segments.tr: - **Agentes:** Embarcadores, transportadoras, agentes de carga, NVOCCs, despachantes aduaneiros, portos e operadores logísticos (3PLs).

segments.src: - **Contracts & risk:** Incoterms (such as FOB, CIF, and DAP) set who pays for what and where risk transfers. They do not decide who owns the goods.
segments.tr: - **Contratos e risco:** Os Incoterms (como FOB, CIF e DAP) definem quem paga o quê e em que momento o risco é transferido. Eles não determinam quem é o dono da mercadoria.

segments.src: - **Documents:** Commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or air waybill, and certificate of origin.
segments.tr: - **Documentos:** Fatura comercial, romaneio (packing list), conhecimento de embarque ou conhecimento aéreo (air waybill) e certificado de origem.

segments.src: - **Border:** Customs classification (HS codes), valuation, duties, and trade agreements.
segments.tr: - **Fronteira:** Classificação aduaneira (códigos HS), valoração, tributos e acordos comerciais.

segments.src: - **Money:** Total landed cost = product + freight + insurance + duties + handling + inventory carrying cost.
segments.tr: - **Dinheiro:** Custo total de entrega = produto + frete + seguro + tributos + manuseio + custo de carregamento do estoque.

segments.src: - **Resilience:** Chokepoints, port congestion, and diversification, now joined by data visibility and carbon cost.
segments.tr: - **Resiliência:** Pontos de estrangulamento, congestionamento portuário e diversificação, agora somados à visibilidade de dados e ao custo de carbono.

segments.src: ## 📚 Key Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Termos-Chave

segments.src: - **IoT tracker:** A connected sensor on cargo that reports location and conditions (such as temperature) in near real time.
segments.tr: - **Rastreador IoT:** Um sensor conectado à carga que informa localização e condições (como temperatura) em tempo quase real.

segments.src: - **Electronic Bill of Lading (eBL):** A digital version of the bill of lading that keeps its roles as receipt, contract evidence, and document of title.
segments.tr: - **Conhecimento de Embarque Eletrônico (eBL):** Versão digital do conhecimento de embarque que mantém seus papéis de recibo, prova contratual e título de propriedade.

segments.src: - **Digital twin:** A virtual model of a physical logistics system, used to simulate and optimize operations.
segments.tr: - **Gêmeo digital:** Modelo virtual de um sistema logístico físico, usado para simular e otimizar operações.

segments.src: - **CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator):** An IMO rating (A to E) of how much CO2 a ship emits per unit of transport work over a year.
segments.tr: - **CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator):** Classificação da IMO (de A a E) que indica quanto CO2 um navio emite por unidade de trabalho de transporte ao longo de um ano.

segments.src: - **Slow steaming:** Deliberately running ships at lower speeds to cut fuel use and emissions, which lengthens transit times.
segments.tr: - **Navegação lenta (slow steaming):** Operar deliberadamente os navios em velocidades menores para reduzir o consumo de combustível e as emissões, o que alonga os tempos de trânsito.

segments.src: Some rules already apply.
segments.tr: Beberapa aturan sudah berlaku.

segments.src: Since January 2023, ships have been rated on energy efficiency (**EEXI**) and on yearly carbon intensity (**CII**, a grade from A to E).
segments.tr: Sejak Januari 2023, kapal dinilai berdasarkan efisiensi energi (**EEXI**) dan intensitas karbon tahunan (**CII**, peringkat dari A hingga E).

segments.src: The IMO is also developing a global framework that would combine a fuel-emissions standard with a carbon price.
segments.tr: IMO juga sedang mengembangkan kerangka global yang akan menggabungkan standar emisi bahan bakar dengan harga karbon.

segments.src: Member states approved a draft in April 2025, but the vote to formally adopt it was postponed in October 2025.
segments.tr: Negara-negara anggota menyetujui rancangan pada April 2025, tetapi pemungutan suara untuk mengadopsinya secara resmi ditunda pada Oktober 2025.

segments.src: The final shape and timing of this global measure are still being negotiated.
segments.tr: Bentuk akhir dan waktu pelaksanaan langkah global ini masih dinegosiasikan.

segments.src: Regional rules are moving faster.
segments.tr: Aturan regional bergerak lebih cepat.

segments.src: Since 2024, the **EU Emissions Trading System** has required shipping companies to buy allowances for emissions on voyages to and from EU ports.
segments.tr: Sejak 2024, **EU Emissions Trading System** mewajibkan perusahaan pelayaran membeli izin emisi untuk pelayaran dari dan ke pelabuhan UE.

segments.src: **FuelEU Maritime** started in 2025 and requires the fuel used on board to become gradually less carbon-intensive.
segments.tr: **FuelEU Maritime** dimulai pada 2025 dan mewajibkan bahan bakar yang digunakan di kapal secara bertahap menjadi lebih rendah intensitas karbonnya.

segments.src: What changes in practice:
segments.tr: Yang berubah dalam praktik:

segments.src: - **Slow steaming.** Ships sail slower to burn less fuel, so transit times get longer.
segments.tr: - **Slow steaming.** Kapal berlayar lebih lambat untuk membakar lebih sedikit bahan bakar, sehingga waktu tempuh menjadi lebih lama.

segments.src: - **New fuels.** LNG, methanol, and ammonia are being tested or adopted, and each comes with its own cost and infrastructure challenges.
segments.tr: - **Bahan bakar baru.** LNG, metanol, dan amonia sedang diuji atau mulai diadopsi, dan masing-masing membawa tantangan biaya dan infrastruktur sendiri.

segments.src: - **Carbon surcharges.** Carriers pass compliance costs to shippers as new line items on freight invoices.
segments.tr: - **Surcharge karbon.** Pengangkut membebankan biaya kepatuhan kepada pengirim sebagai item baris baru pada faktur pengiriman.

segments.src: Put simply, **emissions are becoming a cost that shows up on the invoice.** That puts carbon in the same category as fuel or port fees.
segments.tr: Sederhananya, **emisi menjadi biaya yang muncul di faktur.** Hal ini menempatkan karbon pada kategori yang sama dengan bahan bakar atau biaya pelabuhan.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Think of a mid-sized home-goods retailer in Columbus, Ohio, that imports ceramic cookware from a factory near Shanghai.
segments.tr: Bayangkan sebuah peritel perlengkapan rumah berukuran menengah di Columbus, Ohio, yang mengimpor peralatan masak keramik dari pabrik dekat Shanghai.

segments.src: A few years ago, the import manager tracked the container by checking the carrier's website and emailing the freight forwarder.
segments.tr: Beberapa tahun lalu, manajer impor melacak kontainer dengan memeriksa situs web pengangkut dan mengirim email ke forwarder.

segments.src: When the ship waited offshore at the Port of Los Angeles, they found out late and had to pay for expedited trucking to get products on shelves before Black Friday.
segments.tr: Ketika kapal menunggu di lepas pantai Pelabuhan Los Angeles, mereka baru tahu belakangan dan harus membayar pengiriman truk ekspres agar produk sampai di rak sebelum Black Friday.

segments.src: Today, the container has a GPS tracker.
segments.tr: Sekarang, kontainer itu memiliki pelacak GPS.

segments.src: The forwarder's dashboard shows a predicted arrival that updates when congestion builds at the port.
segments.tr: Dasbor forwarder menampilkan perkiraan waktu tiba yang diperbarui ketika kemacetan terjadi di pelabuhan.

segments.src: The bill of lading is electronic, so the customs broker can file entry documents before the ship berths.
segments.tr: Konosemennya elektronik, sehingga broker bea cukai dapat mengajukan dokumen masuk sebelum kapal bersandar.

segments.src: When the dashboard flagged a likely four-day delay, the retailer switched part of the shipment to an East Coast routing ahead of time.
segments.tr: Ketika dasbor menandai kemungkinan keterlambatan empat hari, peritel tersebut mengalihkan sebagian pengiriman ke rute Pantai Timur sejak awal.

segments.src: Their freight quote also includes a new line: an environmental or emissions surcharge from the ocean carrier.
segments.tr: Penawaran tarif kargo mereka juga mencakup item baru: surcharge lingkungan atau emisi dari pengangkut laut.

segments.src: On a $3,000 container move, it may be a small share of the total, but the retailer's buyers now compare carriers on the cost and carbon profile of each lane as well as on rate and speed.
segments.tr: Untuk pengiriman kontainer senilai $3.000, jumlahnya mungkin hanya sebagian kecil dari total, tetapi pembeli peritel kini membandingkan pengangkut berdasarkan biaya dan profil karbon setiap rute, bukan hanya tarif dan kecepatan.

segments.src: Some large US brands also ask suppliers for shipment-level emissions data to support their corporate climate reporting.
segments.tr: Beberapa merek besar AS juga meminta pemasok menyediakan data emisi per pengiriman untuk mendukung pelaporan iklim perusahaan mereka.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris

segments.src: 1. Digital logistics (IoT tracking, electronic bills of lading, shared data platforms, digital twins) aims at **end-to-end visibility**, which allows earlier decisions and leaner inventory.
segments.tr: 1. Logistik digital (pelacakan IoT, konosemen elektronik, platform data bersama, digital twin) bertujuan mencapai **visibilitas ujung ke ujung**, yang memungkinkan keputusan lebih awal dan inventaris yang lebih ramping.

segments.src: 2. IMO targets (net-zero by around 2050) plus regional rules like the EU ETS and FuelEU Maritime are turning **carbon into a real shipping cost**, which shippers see as surcharges and slower sailings.
segments.tr: 2. Target IMO (nol bersih sekitar 2050) ditambah aturan regional seperti EU ETS dan FuelEU Maritime menjadikan **karbon sebagai biaya pelayaran yang nyata**, yang dirasakan pengirim sebagai surcharge dan pelayaran yang lebih lambat.

segments.src: 3. These trends sit on top of the course fundamentals: **choosing the mode, using Incoterms, clearing customs, and managing total landed cost.** Technology and regulation change the inputs, but the logic stays the same.
segments.tr: 3. Tren ini berdiri di atas dasar-dasar kursus: **memilih moda, menggunakan Incoterms, melakukan kepabeanan, dan mengelola total landed cost.** Teknologi dan regulasi mengubah masukannya, tetapi logikanya tetap sama.

segments.src: **Course wrap-up: the big picture in one pass**
segments.tr: **Rangkuman akhir kursus: gambaran besar dalam sekali pandang**

segments.src: - **Modes:** Ocean freight is cheap and slow. Air freight is fast and expensive. Rail and truck connect the inland legs. Intermodal shipping combines them, usually built around the standard container (TEU/FEU).
segments.tr: - **Moda:** Angkutan laut murah dan lambat. Angkutan udara cepat dan mahal. Kereta dan truk menghubungkan rute darat. Intermodal menggabungkannya, biasanya dibangun di sekitar kontainer standar (TEU/FEU).

segments.src: - **Players:** Shippers, carriers, freight forwarders, NVOCCs, customs brokers, ports, and 3PLs.
segments.tr: - **Pelaku:** Pengirim, pengangkut, freight forwarder, NVOCC, broker bea cukai, pelabuhan, dan 3PL.

segments.src: - **Contracts & risk:** Incoterms (such as FOB, CIF, and DAP) set who pays for what and where risk transfers. They do not decide who owns the goods.
segments.tr: - **Kontrak & risiko:** Incoterms (seperti FOB, CIF, dan DAP) menentukan siapa membayar apa dan di mana risiko berpindah. Incoterms tidak menentukan siapa pemilik barang.

segments.src: - **Documents:** Commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or air waybill, and certificate of origin.
segments.tr: - **Dokumen:** Faktur komersial, daftar kemasan, konosemen atau air waybill, dan sertifikat asal.

segments.src: - **Border:** Customs classification (HS codes), valuation, duties, and trade agreements.
segments.tr: - **Perbatasan:** Klasifikasi bea cukai (kode HS), penilaian, bea masuk, dan perjanjian perdagangan.

segments.src: - **Money:** Total landed cost = product + freight + insurance + duties + handling + inventory carrying cost.
segments.tr: - **Uang:** Total landed cost = produk + kargo + asuransi + bea masuk + penanganan + biaya penyimpanan inventaris.

segments.src: - **Resilience:** Chokepoints, port congestion, and diversification, now joined by data visibility and carbon cost.
segments.tr: - **Ketahanan:** Titik sempit, kemacetan pelabuhan, dan diversifikasi, kini ditambah visibilitas data dan biaya karbon.

segments.src: ## 📚 Key Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Istilah Kunci

segments.src: - **IoT tracker:** A connected sensor on cargo that reports location and conditions (such as temperature) in near real time.
segments.tr: - **Pelacak IoT:** Sensor terhubung pada kargo yang melaporkan lokasi dan kondisi (seperti suhu) hampir secara real time.

segments.src: - **Electronic Bill of Lading (eBL):** A digital version of the bill of lading that keeps its roles as receipt, contract evidence, and document of title.
segments.tr: - **Konosemen Elektronik (eBL):** Versi digital dari konosemen yang tetap menjalankan perannya sebagai tanda terima, bukti kontrak, dan dokumen kepemilikan.

segments.src: - **Digital twin:** A virtual model of a physical logistics system, used to simulate and optimize operations.
segments.tr: - **Digital twin:** Model virtual dari sistem logistik fisik, digunakan untuk mensimulasikan dan mengoptimalkan operasi.

segments.src: - **CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator):** An IMO rating (A to E) of how much CO2 a ship emits per unit of transport work over a year.
segments.tr: - **CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator):** Peringkat IMO (A hingga E) tentang seberapa banyak CO2 yang dikeluarkan kapal per satuan kerja pengangkutan selama setahun.

segments.src: - **Slow steaming:** Deliberately running ships at lower speeds to cut fuel use and emissions, which lengthens transit times.
segments.tr: - **Slow steaming:** Sengaja menjalankan kapal dengan kecepatan lebih rendah untuk memangkas penggunaan bahan bakar dan emisi, yang memperpanjang waktu transit.

ja.title: [International Logistics #15] スマートなデータ、クリーンな船舶：世界の貨物輸送の行方と全課程の総復習

segments.src: > Global logistics is changing in two ways at once. Data is making each shipment visible from start to finish, and climate rules are changing what ships burn and what that costs. Both changes build on the basics: modes, documents, contracts, and costs.
segments.tr: > 世界の物流は、同時に二つの方向で変わりつつあります。データによって一つひとつの貨物を出発から到着まで追跡できるようになり、気候規制によって船が燃やす燃料と、その費用が変わりつつあります。どちらの変化も、輸送モード、書類、契約、コストという基本の上に成り立っています。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日のコンセプト

segments.src: Smart (digital) logistics: from "Where is my box?"
segments.tr: スマート（デジタル）物流：「私の箱はどこ？」から

segments.src: to "I already know"**
segments.tr: 「もう分かっている」へ**

segments.src: For most of its history, international shipping ran on paper and phone calls.
segments.tr: 国際輸送はその歴史の大半を、紙の書類と電話連絡によって行われてきました。

segments.src: A shipper often learned a container was late only after it failed to show up.
segments.tr: 荷主はコンテナが遅れていると、到着しないことで初めて気づくことが多くありました。

segments.src: Digital logistics tries to close that information gap.
segments.tr: デジタル物流は、この情報の空白を埋めようとするものです。

segments.src: Here are the main tools:
segments.tr: 主なツールは次のとおりです：

segments.src: - **IoT sensors and trackers.** These are small devices on containers or pallets that report location, temperature, humidity, or shock. They matter most for "reefer" (refrigerated) cargo such as fruit or vaccines.
segments.tr: - **IoTセンサーとトラッカー。** コンテナやパレットに取り付ける小型デバイスで、位置、温度、湿度、衝撃などを報告します。果物やワクチンなどの「リーファー」（冷蔵）貨物で特に重要です。

segments.src: - **Electronic Bill of Lading (eBL).** The bill of lading is the key shipping document. It serves as a receipt, a contract of carriage, and, in its negotiable form, a document of title. Paper originals often travel by courier and can arrive after the ship does. An eBL moves that same function online. Laws that recognize electronic trade documents, such as the UK's Electronic Trade Documents Act 2023, have made eBLs easier to adopt.
segments.tr: - **電子船荷証券（eBL）。** 船荷証券は海上輸送の中心的な書類です。受取証、運送契約、そして譲渡可能な形式では権利証券としての役割を担います。紙の原本は通常、宅配で運ばれるため、船の到着後に届くこともあります。eBLは同じ機能をオンラインで実現します。英国の2023年電子貿易書類法（Electronic Trade Documents Act 2023）のように電子貿易書類を認める法律が整ったことで、eBLは導入しやすくなりました。

segments.src: - **Platforms and data sharing.** Carriers, ports, forwarders, and customs agencies increasingly share data through standard formats and APIs. That lets everyone work from the same estimated arrival time.
segments.tr: - **プラットフォームとデータ共有。** 船会社、港湾、フォワーダー、税関は、標準フォーマットやAPIを通じてデータを共有するようになっています。これにより、関係者全員が同じ到着予定時刻をもとに作業できます。

segments.src: - **Digital twins and AI forecasting.** A digital twin is a virtual model of a port, warehouse, or network. Companies use it to test scenarios, such as "What if this terminal closes for three days?", before they happen in real life.
segments.tr: - **デジタルツインとAI予測。** デジタルツインとは、港湾、倉庫、ネットワークを仮想的にモデル化したものです。企業はこれを使い、「このターミナルが3日間閉鎖したらどうなるか？」といったシナリオを、実際に起こる前に検証します。

segments.src: The goal is **visibility**, and visibility makes three things possible: planning ahead, holding less safety stock, and reacting faster when something goes wrong.
segments.tr: 目指すのは**可視性**であり、可視性があれば、先を見越した計画、安全在庫の削減、問題発生時のより迅速な対応が可能になります。

segments.src: Green logistics: the decarbonization squeeze**
segments.tr: グリーン物流：脱炭素化の板挟み**

segments.src: Shipping carries roughly 80% of world trade by volume.
segments.tr: 海上輸送は、世界貿易の量の約80%を担っています。

segments.src: It also produces about 3% of global greenhouse gas emissions.
segments.tr: また、世界の温室効果ガス排出量の約3%を生み出しています。

segments.src: The **International Maritime Organization (IMO)**, the UN agency that regulates shipping, adopted a revised GHG Strategy in 2023 with these targets:
segments.tr: 海運を規制する国連の専門機関である**国際海事機関（IMO）**は、2023年に改訂版GHG戦略を採択し、次の目標を掲げました：

segments.src: - Reach **net-zero emissions by or around 2050**
segments.tr: - 2050年頃までに**ネットゼロ排出**を達成する

segments.src: - Cut emissions by at least 20% (striving for 30%) by 2030 and by at least 70% (striving for 80%) by 2040, both compared with 2008 levels
segments.tr: - 2008年比で、2030年までに少なくとも20%（30%を目指す）、2040年までに少なくとも70%（80%を目指す）削減する

segments.src: Some rules already apply.
segments.tr: すでに一部の規則は適用されています。

segments.src: Since January 2023, ships have been rated on energy efficiency (**EEXI**) and on yearly carbon intensity (**CII**, a grade from A to E).
segments.tr: 2023年1月以降、船舶はエネルギー効率（**EEXI**）と、年間の炭素強度（**CII**、AからEまでの等級）で評価されています。

segments.src: The IMO is also developing a global framework that would combine a fuel-emissions standard with a carbon price.
segments.tr: IMOはまた、燃料排出基準と炭素価格を組み合わせたグローバルな枠組みも策定中です。

segments.src: Member states approved a draft in April 2025, but the vote to formally adopt it was postponed in October 2025.
segments.tr: 加盟国は2025年4月に草案を承認しましたが、正式採択に向けた投票は2025年10月に延期されました。

segments.src: The final shape and timing of this global measure are still being negotiated.
segments.tr: このグローバルな措置の最終的な形と実施時期は、現在も交渉が続いています。

segments.src: Regional rules are moving faster.
segments.tr: 地域的な規則のほうが速く進んでいます。

segments.src: Since 2024, the **EU Emissions Trading System** has required shipping companies to buy allowances for emissions on voyages to and from EU ports.
segments.tr: 2024年以降、**EU排出量取引制度（EU ETS）**により、船会社はEUの港への出入りの航海で排出量の枠を購入することが求められています。

segments.src: **FuelEU Maritime** started in 2025 and requires the fuel used on board to become gradually less carbon-intensive.
segments.tr: **FuelEU Maritime**は2025年に始まり、船上で使用される燃料を段階的に炭素集約度の低いものにすることを求めています。

segments.src: What changes in practice:
segments.tr: 実際に変わることは次のとおりです：

segments.src: - **Slow steaming.** Ships sail slower to burn less fuel, so transit times get longer.
segments.tr: - **スロースチーミング（減速航行）。** 燃料消費を抑えるため船が速度を落として航行するため、輸送期間が長くなります。

segments.src: - **New fuels.** LNG, methanol, and ammonia are being tested or adopted, and each comes with its own cost and infrastructure challenges.
segments.tr: - **新燃料。** LNG、メタノール、アンモニアが試験または導入されており、それぞれ固有のコストやインフラの課題を伴います。

segments.src: - **Carbon surcharges.** Carriers pass compliance costs to shippers as new line items on freight invoices.
segments.tr: - **カーボンサーチャージ。** 船会社は、規制対応コストを輸送請求書の新しい費目として荷主に転嫁しています。

segments.src: Put simply, **emissions are becoming a cost that shows up on the invoice.** That puts carbon in the same category as fuel or port fees.
segments.tr: 簡単に言えば、**排出は請求書に表示されるコストになりつつあります。** これにより、炭素は燃料費や港湾料金と同じ性質のものになります。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活の中で

segments.src: Think of a mid-sized home-goods retailer in Columbus, Ohio, that imports ceramic cookware from a factory near Shanghai.
segments.tr: オハイオ州コロンバスにある中規模の家庭用品小売業者を想像してください。この業者は、上海近郊の工場からセラミック製の調理器具を輸入しています。

segments.src: A few years ago, the import manager tracked the container by checking the carrier's website and emailing the freight forwarder.
segments.tr: 数年前、輸入担当者は船会社のウェブサイトを確認し、フォワーダーにメールを送ることでコンテナを追跡していました。

segments.src: When the ship waited offshore at the Port of Los Angeles, they found out late and had to pay for expedited trucking to get products on shelves before Black Friday.
segments.tr: 船がロサンゼルス港沖で待機していたとき、その遅延を知ったのは遅くなってからで、ブラックフライデーまでに商品を売り場に並べるため、特急トラック輸送の費用を支払わなければなりませんでした。

segments.src: Today, the container has a GPS tracker.
segments.tr: 現在、コンテナにはGPSトラッカーが付いています。

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 3行まとめ

segments.src: 1. Digital logistics (IoT tracking, electronic bills of lading, shared data platforms, digital twins) aims at **end-to-end visibility**, which allows earlier decisions and leaner inventory.

segments.src: 2. IMO targets (net-zero by around 2050) plus regional rules like the EU ETS and FuelEU Maritime are turning **carbon into a real shipping cost**, which shippers see as surcharges and slower sailings.
segments.tr: 2. IMOの目標（2050年頃のネットゼロ）と、EU ETSやFuelEU Maritimeといった地域規則により、**炭素は実質的な海上輸送コスト**になりつつあり、荷主はそれをサーチャージや航海速度の低下として実感しています。

segments.src: 3. These trends sit on top of the course fundamentals: **choosing the mode, using Incoterms, clearing customs, and managing total landed cost.** Technology and regulation change the inputs, but the logic stays the same.

de.title: [International Logistics #15] Smartere Daten, sauberere Schiffe: Wohin sich die globale Fracht entwickelt, plus ein Überblick über den gesamten Kurs

segments.src: > Global logistics is changing in two ways at once. Data is making each shipment visible from start to finish, and climate rules are changing what ships burn and what that costs. Both changes build on the basics: modes, documents, contracts, and costs.
segments.tr: > Die globale Logistik verändert sich gleichzeitig auf zwei Wegen. Daten machen jede Sendung von Anfang bis Ende sichtbar, und Klimavorschriften verändern, welche Kraftstoffe Schiffe verbrennen und was das kostet. Beide Veränderungen bauen auf den Grundlagen auf: Transportarten, Dokumente, Verträge und Kosten.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Heutiges Konzept

segments.src: Smart (digital) logistics: from "Where is my box?"
segments.tr: Smarte (digitale) Logistik: von „Wo ist meine Box?“

segments.src: to "I already know"**
segments.tr: zu „Ich weiß es bereits“**

segments.src: For most of its history, international shipping ran on paper and phone calls.
segments.tr: Über den größten Teil ihrer Geschichte lief die internationale Schifffahrt über Papier und Telefonate.

segments.src: A shipper often learned a container was late only after it failed to show up.
segments.tr: Ein Versender erfuhr oft erst dann, dass sich ein Container verspätet hatte, wenn er nicht auftauchte.

segments.src: Digital logistics tries to close that information gap.
segments.tr: Digitale Logistik will diese Informationslücke schließen.

segments.src: Here are the main tools:
segments.tr: Dies sind die wichtigsten Werkzeuge:

segments.src: - **IoT sensors and trackers.** These are small devices on containers or pallets that report location, temperature, humidity, or shock. They matter most for "reefer" (refrigerated) cargo such as fruit or vaccines.
segments.tr: - **IoT-Sensoren und Tracker.** Dies sind kleine Geräte an Containern oder Paletten, die Standort, Temperatur, Luftfeuchtigkeit oder Erschütterungen melden. Sie sind vor allem bei „Reefer“-Fracht (Kühlcontainer), etwa bei Obst oder Impfstoffen, wichtig.

segments.src: - **Electronic Bill of Lading (eBL).** The bill of lading is the key shipping document. It serves as a receipt, a contract of carriage, and, in its negotiable form, a document of title. Paper originals often travel by courier and can arrive after the ship does. An eBL moves that same function online. Laws that recognize electronic trade documents, such as the UK's Electronic Trade Documents Act 2023, have made eBLs easier to adopt.
segments.tr: - **Elektronisches Konossement (eBL).** Das Konossement ist das zentrale Versanddokument. Es dient als Empfangsbescheinigung, als Beförderungsvertrag und in seiner übertragbaren Form als Traditionspapier. Papieroriginale werden oft per Kurier befördert und können erst nach dem Schiff ankommen. Ein eBL übernimmt dieselbe Funktion online. Gesetze, die elektronische Handelsdokumente anerkennen, etwa der britische Electronic Trade Documents Act 2023, haben die Einführung von eBLs erleichtert.

segments.src: - **Platforms and data sharing.** Carriers, ports, forwarders, and customs agencies increasingly share data through standard formats and APIs. That lets everyone work from the same estimated arrival time.
segments.tr: - **Plattformen und Datenaustausch.** Reedereien, Häfen, Spediteure und Zollbehörden tauschen Daten zunehmend über Standardformate und APIs aus. So arbeiten alle mit derselben geschätzten Ankunftszeit.

segments.src: - **Digital twins and AI forecasting.** A digital twin is a virtual model of a port, warehouse, or network. Companies use it to test scenarios, such as "What if this terminal closes for three days?", before they happen in real life.
segments.tr: - **Digitale Zwillinge und KI-Prognosen.** Ein digitaler Zwilling ist ein virtuelles Modell eines Hafens, Lagers oder Netzwerks. Unternehmen nutzen ihn, um Szenarien zu testen, etwa „Was passiert, wenn dieses Terminal drei Tage geschlossen ist?“, bevor sie in der Realität eintreten.

segments.src: The goal is **visibility**, and visibility makes three things possible: planning ahead, holding less safety stock, and reacting faster when something goes wrong.
segments.tr: Das Ziel ist **Transparenz**, und Transparenz ermöglicht drei Dinge: vorausschauende Planung, geringere Sicherheitsbestände und schnellere Reaktion, wenn etwas schiefgeht.

segments.src: Green logistics: the decarbonization squeeze**
segments.tr: Grüne Logistik: der Druck zur Dekarbonisierung**

segments.src: Shipping carries roughly 80% of world trade by volume.
segments.tr: Die Schifffahrt wickelt rund 80 % des Welthandels nach Volumen ab.

segments.src: It also produces about 3% of global greenhouse gas emissions.
segments.tr: Sie verursacht außerdem etwa 3 % der globalen Treibhausgasemissionen.

segments.src: The **International Maritime Organization (IMO)**, the UN agency that regulates shipping, adopted a revised GHG Strategy in 2023 with these targets:
segments.tr: Die **Internationale Seeschifffahrts-Organisation (IMO)**, die UN-Organisation, die die Schifffahrt reguliert, hat 2023 eine überarbeitete THG-Strategie mit folgenden Zielen verabschiedet:

segments.src: - Reach **net-zero emissions by or around 2050**
segments.tr: - Bis **etwa 2050 Netto-Null-Emissionen** erreichen

segments.src: - Cut emissions by at least 20% (striving for 30%) by 2030 and by at least 70% (striving for 80%) by 2040, both compared with 2008 levels
segments.tr: - Die Emissionen bis 2030 um mindestens 20 % (angestrebt 30 %) und bis 2040 um mindestens 70 % (angestrebt 80 %) gegenüber dem Niveau von 2008 senken

segments.src: Some rules already apply.
segments.tr: Einige Regeln gelten bereits.

segments.src: Since January 2023, ships have been rated on energy efficiency (**EEXI**) and on yearly carbon intensity (**CII**, a grade from A to E).
segments.tr: Seit Januar 2023 werden Schiffe nach ihrer Energieeffizienz (**EEXI**) und nach ihrer jährlichen Kohlenstoffintensität (**CII**, eine Note von A bis E) bewertet.

segments.src: The IMO is also developing a global framework that would combine a fuel-emissions standard with a carbon price.
segments.tr: Die IMO entwickelt außerdem einen globalen Rahmen, der einen Kraftstoff-Emissionsstandard mit einem CO₂-Preis verbinden würde.

segments.src: Member states approved a draft in April 2025, but the vote to formally adopt it was postponed in October 2025.
segments.tr: Die Mitgliedstaaten billigten im April 2025 einen Entwurf, doch die förmliche Abstimmung über die Annahme wurde im Oktober 2025 verschoben.

segments.src: The final shape and timing of this global measure are still being negotiated.
segments.tr: Form und Zeitplan dieser globalen Maßnahme werden noch verhandelt.

segments.src: Regional rules are moving faster.
segments.tr: Regionale Regeln bewegen sich schneller.

segments.src: Since 2024, the **EU Emissions Trading System** has required shipping companies to buy allowances for emissions on voyages to and from EU ports.
segments.tr: Seit 2024 verpflichtet das **EU-Emissionshandelssystem (EU-EHS)** Reedereien, für Emissionen auf Fahrten von und zu EU-Häfen Emissionszertifikate zu kaufen.

segments.src: **FuelEU Maritime** started in 2025 and requires the fuel used on board to become gradually less carbon-intensive.
segments.tr: **FuelEU Maritime** begann 2025 und verlangt, dass der an Bord verwendete Kraftstoff schrittweise weniger kohlenstoffintensiv wird.

segments.src: What changes in practice:
segments.tr: In der Praxis ändert sich Folgendes:

segments.src: - **Slow steaming.** Ships sail slower to burn less fuel, so transit times get longer.
segments.tr: - **Langsame Fahrt (Slow Steaming).** Schiffe fahren langsamer, um weniger Kraftstoff zu verbrauchen, wodurch sich die Transitzeiten verlängern.

segments.src: - **New fuels.** LNG, methanol, and ammonia are being tested or adopted, and each comes with its own cost and infrastructure challenges.
segments.tr: - **Neue Kraftstoffe.** LNG, Methanol und Ammoniak werden getestet oder eingeführt; jeder bringt eigene Kosten- und Infrastrukturprobleme mit sich.

segments.src: - **Carbon surcharges.** Carriers pass compliance costs to shippers as new line items on freight invoices.
segments.tr: - **CO₂-Zuschläge.** Reedereien geben Compliance-Kosten als neue Positionen auf Frachtrechnungen an Versender weiter.

segments.src: Put simply, **emissions are becoming a cost that shows up on the invoice.** That puts carbon in the same category as fuel or port fees.
segments.tr: Vereinfacht gesagt: **Emissionen werden zu einem Kostenfaktor, der auf der Rechnung erscheint.** Damit gehört CO₂ in dieselbe Kategorie wie Kraftstoff oder Hafengebühren.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Im Alltag

segments.src: Think of a mid-sized home-goods retailer in Columbus, Ohio, that imports ceramic cookware from a factory near Shanghai.
segments.tr: Stellen Sie sich einen mittelgroßen Einzelhändler für Haushaltswaren in Columbus, Ohio, vor, der Keramikgeschirr aus einer Fabrik in der Nähe von Shanghai importiert.

segments.tr: Vor einigen Jahren verfolgte der Importleiter den Container, indem er die Website der Reederei prüfte und dem Spediteur E-Mails schrieb.

segments.tr: Als das Schiff vor dem Hafen von Los Angeles wartete, erfuhr er dies zu spät und musste teure Eilspedition bezahlen, damit die Ware vor dem Black Friday in den Regalen stand.

segments.tr: Heute hat der Container einen GPS-Tracker.

segments.tr: Das Dashboard des Spediteurs zeigt eine voraussichtliche Ankunftszeit, die sich aktualisiert, sobald sich am Hafen Staus bilden.

segments.src: The bill of lading is electronic, so the customs broker can file entry documents before the ship berths.
segments.tr: Das Konossement ist elektronisch, sodass der Zollmakler die Einfuhrdokumente einreichen kann, bevor das Schiff anlegt.

segments.src: When the dashboard flagged a likely four-day delay, the retailer switched part of the shipment to an East Coast routing ahead of time.
segments.tr: Als das Dashboard eine wahrscheinliche Verzögerung von vier Tagen anzeigte, verlagerte der Einzelhändler rechtzeitig einen Teil der Sendung auf eine Route über die Ostküste.

segments.src: Their freight quote also includes a new line: an environmental or emissions surcharge from the ocean carrier.
segments.tr: Auch ihr Frachtangebot enthält nun eine neue Position: einen Umwelt- oder Emissionszuschlag der Seereederei.

segments.src: On a $3,000 container move, it may be a small share of the total, but the retailer's buyers now compare carriers on the cost and carbon profile of each lane as well as on rate and speed.
segments.tr: Bei einem Containertransport im Wert von 3.000 $ mag das nur einen kleinen Anteil der Gesamtkosten ausmachen, aber die Einkäufer des Einzelhändlers vergleichen Reedereien nun auch nach dem Kosten- und CO₂-Profil jeder Route, nicht nur nach Rate und Geschwindigkeit.

segments.src: **Course wrap-up: the big picture in one pass**
segments.tr: **Kursabschluss: das große Bild in einem Durchgang**

segments.src: - **Modes:** Ocean freight is cheap and slow. Air freight is fast and expensive. Rail and truck connect the inland legs. Intermodal shipping combines them, usually built around the standard container (TEU/FEU).
segments.tr: - **Transportarten:** Seefracht ist günstig und langsam. Luftfracht ist schnell und teuer. Schiene und Lkw verbinden die Hinterlandstrecken. Kombinierter Verkehr verbindet sie und basiert meist auf dem Standardcontainer (TEU/FEU).

segments.src: - **Players:** Shippers, carriers, freight forwarders, NVOCCs, customs brokers, ports, and 3PLs.
segments.tr: - **Akteure:** Versender, Reedereien, Spediteure, NVOCCs, Zollmakler, Häfen und 3PLs.

segments.src: - **Contracts & risk:** Incoterms (such as FOB, CIF, and DAP) set who pays for what and where risk transfers. They do not decide who owns the goods.
segments.tr: - **Verträge & Risiko:** Incoterms (etwa FOB, CIF und DAP) regeln, wer was bezahlt und wann das Risiko übergeht. Sie bestimmen nicht, wem die Ware gehört.

segments.src: - **Documents:** Commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading or air waybill, and certificate of origin.
segments.tr: - **Dokumente:** Handelsrechnung, Packliste, Konossement oder Luftfrachtbrief sowie Ursprungszeugnis.

segments.src: - **Border:** Customs classification (HS codes), valuation, duties, and trade agreements.
segments.tr: - **Grenze:** Zolltarifierung (HS-Codes), Zollwert, Abgaben und Handelsabkommen.

segments.src: - **Money:** Total landed cost = product + freight + insurance + duties + handling + inventory carrying cost.
segments.tr: - **Geld:** Gesamtkosten bei Ankunft = Ware + Fracht + Versicherung + Zölle + Handling + Lagerhaltungskosten.

segments.src: - **Resilience:** Chokepoints, port congestion, and diversification, now joined by data visibility and carbon cost.
segments.tr: - **Resilienz:** Engpässe, Hafenstaus und Diversifizierung, inzwischen ergänzt durch Datentransparenz und CO₂-Kosten.

segments.src: ## 📚 Key Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Schlüsselbegriffe

segments.src: - **IoT tracker:** A connected sensor on cargo that reports location and conditions (such as temperature) in near real time.
segments.tr: - **IoT-Tracker:** Ein vernetzter Sensor an der Fracht, der Standort und Bedingungen (etwa Temperatur) nahezu in Echtzeit meldet.

segments.src: - **Electronic Bill of Lading (eBL):** A digital version of the bill of lading that keeps its roles as receipt, contract evidence, and document of title.
segments.tr: - **Elektronisches Konossement (eBL):** Eine digitale Form des Konossements, die seine Funktionen als Empfangsbescheinigung, Vertragsnachweis und Traditionspapier beibehält.

segments.src: - **Digital twin:** A virtual model of a physical logistics system, used to simulate and optimize operations.
segments.tr: - **Digitaler Zwilling:** Ein virtuelles Modell eines physischen Logistiksystems, das zur Simulation und Optimierung von Abläufen dient.

segments.src: - **CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator):** An IMO rating (A to E) of how much CO2 a ship emits per unit of transport work over a year.
segments.tr: - **CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator):** Eine IMO-Bewertung (A bis E), wie viel CO₂ ein Schiff pro Transportleistung über ein Jahr ausstößt.

segments.src: - **Slow steaming:** Deliberately running ships at lower speeds to cut fuel use and emissions, which lengthens transit times.
segments.tr: - **Langsame Fahrt (Slow Steaming):** Das bewusste Fahren mit niedrigerer Geschwindigkeit, um Kraftstoffverbrauch und Emissionen zu senken; dadurch verlängern sich die Transitzeiten.

segments.tr: Ein eBL überträgt das Traditionspapier digital, sodass Waren nicht auf Papieroriginale warten müssen.
